_comment: Tier-2: SmallDisplacementThermoMechanicElement2D4N needs nodal TEMPERATURE and DAM.NODAL_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE, and Properties needs DAM.THERMAL_EXPANSION — the Dam variable, not the StructuralMechanics one. Pitfall (kratos.dam #3). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Both NODAL_REFERENCE_TEMPERATURE and THERMAL_EXPANSION resolve on DamApplication and on NEITHER StructuralMechanicsApplication nor core, so the module the reader would reach for is the wrong one; the element itself constructs. TEMPERATURE is a core variable, so the pair straddles two modules. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. MUTATION CONTROL (added 2026-08-06, re-runnable): T2_MUTATE=1 INVERTS the expected outcome of all 6 probes -- it asserts the opposite of what this build actually does, while leaving each probe's callable untouched so every probe still really runs against Kratos. Every probe[...] line then disagrees with itself and probe_mismatches goes from 0 to 6. This proves the printed booleans come from actually calling into Kratos on this build, and that a wrong claim is caught, rather than the fixture echoing a hard-coded table. Verified: unmutated the fixture PASSES; with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS and these expect_in_output strings disappear: all 6 probe[<label>]=<ok>_expected=<must> lines, probe_mismatches=0. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/kratos/dam_thermomech_element_variables && /usr/bin/python3 source.py (passes), then T2_MUTATE=1 /usr/bin/python3 source.py (fails). Interpreter: KRATOS_PYTHON=/usr/bin/python3 is REQUIRED on this host -- the repo venv Kratos wheel is built against GLIBC_2.32 and fails to load (ImportError on Kratos.cpython-312...so), while the system python3.8 carries Kratos 10.4 Release with CableNet, ConstitutiveLaws, StructuralMechanics and LinearSolvers.
